features.title: Registration language preference
features.benefit: Let registrants choose their preferred language at sign-up so their emails and notifications arrive in that language.
features.what: Exhibitor and visitor registration forms can include a Language Preference field. It defaults to the event language and is supported in import and export, and all emails and system notifications use the chosen language.
features.detail: A Language Preference system field was added to exhibitor and visitor registration forms, defaulting to the event language and supported in import and export. All emails and system notifications then use the chosen language.
stories: New system field of "Language Preference" in the Registration Form.

features.title: Registration form field options
features.benefit: Build richer registration forms with website, state/region and city fields, and show the registrant’s category on the confirmation page.
features.what: Custom text fields can be set as website fields, shown as clickable links. Custom select fields can list states/regions or cities. Confirmation page scripts can show the registrant's category, or "No category" when none was chosen.
features.detail: Custom text fields can be set as website fields that render as clickable links. Custom select fields can list states/regions or cities. Confirmation page scripts gain a category variable, showing “No category” when none was chosen.
stories: EMEA: Add the option to make custom text field as a website field
EMEA: Add option for state/region and city field in the custom select field
Need Participant Category type as a variable script in registration Form confirmation page

features.title: Default participant category
features.benefit: Every event now has a default participant category, so uncategorised participants always get sensible limits and settings.
features.what: Each event is created with a default participant category that cannot be deleted and has its own limits and settings. Participants with no category, or whose category is deleted, are assigned to it.
features.detail: The default category is created with each event, cannot be deleted and has its own limits and settings. Participants without a category, or whose category is deleted, fall back to it.
stories: Participant default category

features.title: US English and wording updates
features.benefit: Offer the app in US English and use clearer wording on public profiles.
features.what: The mobile apps offer US English, picked from the phone's locale, with US spellings such as "Favorites". The "Matchmaking information" section on public profiles in the app is now called "Profile Information".
features.detail: The apps pick US English from the phone’s locale, with US spellings such as “Favorites”. The “Matchmaking information” section on public profiles is now called “Profile Information”.
stories: Mobile App - Add support for US English language
Mobile App - Replace Matchmaking Information Wording

features.title: Category and form setup improvements
features.benefit: Control the order participant categories appear in, and avoid duplicate answer options in custom questions.
features.what: Participant categories can be reordered by drag and drop or sorted A to Z and Z to A, and that order is used in frontend filters, registration, booking, admin profiles and the app. Custom questions reject duplicate answer names.
features.detail: Participant categories can be reordered by drag and drop or sorted A–Z/Z–A, and that order is used in frontend filters, registration, booking, admin profiles and the app. Custom questions no longer accept answer options with the same name.
stories: Ticketing order
Prohibit same "names" responses for answers options"

features.what: The Android app has redesigned delegate, buyer, exhibitor, product and brand lists, and new session cards and pages with a Live tag, prices and a book button for paid sessions. It adds a no-results screen and icons share one style and size.
features.detail: Delegate, buyer, exhibitor, product and brand lists, and session cards and pages, were redesigned, with a Live tag, prices and a book button for paid sessions, plus a new no-results screen. Icons across the app follow one consistent style and size.

features.title: UTM tracking on confirmation pages
features.benefit: Attribute registrations to campaigns in Google Analytics, as UTM codes now carry through to the confirmation page.
features.what: UTM parameters from the registration link are carried through to the registration confirmation page, where Google Analytics can read them.
features.detail: UTM parameters from the registration URL are passed through to the registration confirmation page, so registrations can be attributed in Google Analytics.

features.title: Arabic app and multilingual pages
features.benefit: Offer the mobile app in Arabic and open in-app pages in the user’s app language.
features.what: The mobile app is available in Arabic. Edit profile, floor plan, basket, exhibitor events and delegates pages inside the app open in the app's language when the event supports it, otherwise in English.
features.detail: The mobile app was translated into Arabic. Edit profile, floor plan, basket, exhibitor events and delegates pages open in the app language when the event supports it, otherwise in English.

features.title: Category cloning
features.benefit: Duplicate participant and exhibitor categories with all their settings, then change only what differs.
features.what: A Duplicate button copies a participant or exhibitor category with all its settings as a named copy. The categories table adapts to the screen and can be reordered by drag and drop.
features.detail: A Duplicate button copies a category with all its settings as a named copy. The categories table is also adaptive and supports drag-and-drop ordering.
stories: Ability to clone participant and exhibitor categories

features.title: Print badge link on confirmation page
features.benefit: Let visitors print their badge straight from the registration confirmation page.
features.what: A Print Your Badge variable can be added to the visitor registration confirmation page. The link opens the visitor's badge in a new tab, the same as the print option in the profile and admin panel.
features.detail: A Print Your Badge variable can be added to the visitor confirmation page; the link opens the visitor’s badge in a new tab, matching the print option in the profile and admin panel.

features.title: In-app updates
features.benefit: Prompt attendees to update the app when a newer version is available.
features.what: Organisers can enable in-app updates in the app builder and choose between required and optional update prompts, which the apps show when a newer version is released.
features.detail: Organisers enable in-app updates in the app builder and choose required or optional update prompts, which the apps show when a new version is released.

features.title: Discount, invoice and basket improvements
features.benefit: Discounts work in the new basket, invoice payment has its own step, and a direct link adds a session to the basket.
features.what: The new basket applies discounts per section, with multibuy discounts before discount codes, one code at a time. Invoice payment has its own submit step, and a session's Add to basket link adds it to the basket when opened.
features.detail: Discounts were implemented in the new basket, the invoice payment logic was updated, and the session “add to basket” link adds a session to the basket directly when opened.

features.title: Registration field timestamps
features.benefit: Record when a registrant filled in a specific form field and see it in the export.
features.what: Any registration field can be set to record the time of input. The latest input time before registration is completed is stored in event local time and exported as a column next to the field.
features.detail: Any registration field can be flagged to record the time of input. The latest input time before registration completes is stored in event local time and exported as a column next to the field.
stories: FBF: Add the option to record timestamp for a specific field in the registration form

features.what: On launch, the app checks that the user's event still exists. If not, the user is logged out and shown the event selection screen, or the login for the only available event. Collapsing a section on Android keeps the screen in place.
features.detail: On launch the app checks the user’s event still exists; if not, the user is logged out and shown the event selection or login screen. Collapsing sections in the Android app behaves more naturally.

Both show discounts, taxes and totals and allow payment per section or in full. Items are reserved for 15 minutes on the payment page, and the Basket and Discounts modules control what users see.

features.title: Updated VAT rules
features.benefit: Charge VAT correctly based on where the billing and paying companies are located.
features.what: VAT on payments is calculated from where the billing and paying companies are located, with EU VAT number validation and a setting to turn the rules off. For example, tax is zero when a non-EU billing company charges an EU payer.
features.detail: VAT calculation now considers billing and paying company location, EU VAT number validation and a setting to disable VAT rules; for example, tax is zero when a non-EU billing company charges an EU payer.
